currentSlice.detail: The token slice, the detached slice and the persistent-descriptor slice are all written and committed (f8d3bce3d1, 7e470f94bb, 2d2e8f89ac); gate 3 is re-running at 2d2e8f89ac and no cell may be greened until it reports. Observation targets for the batch: P2-02 (#222 plus the spawn cases), P2-04 (base U's 11 cases and the pwsh fixtures), P4-08 (bases C/P/F -- the three greens self-revoked because their freezes postdate run 34432095748, which verify-freeze-in-candidate-tree independently reported as the same 3 MISSING), and P4-09 in full. Still open on P4-08: acceptance[2]'s freeze note must carry §12.74(a)'s wording that the real producer is P6-09 and the saving is not observable here -- it lands when the C/P/F bases are rewritten, not in the entries being superseded. BLOCKED-172 records P6-09's side of that. Remaining detached work from the preFlight: re-attachment along both paths (a live launcher observes through the registry; a gone launcher settles through the outbox).
